pages.text: A drum stores one kind of fluid at a time. Right-click with a full container to fill it, or with an empty container to draw fluid. An empty-handed click reports the fluid and volume. One bucket is 1,000 mB.

pages.title: Capacity by Tier
pages.text: $(li)Stone Drum: 16 buckets.$(li)Iron Drum: 256 buckets.$(li)Reinforced Drum: 4,096 buckets.$(li)Bedrock Drum: 65,536 buckets.$(br2)Connect fluid pipes to any face. A comparator reports how full the drum is.

pages.title: Move a Full Drum
pages.text: Mine a filled drum to move it. The dropped item retains its fluid and restores it when placed.$(br2)Read the item tooltip for what it carries. A drum can directly receive from the Ender Thermic Pump if placed on top.

pages.title: Creative Drum
pages.text: In Creative, right-click an empty Creative Drum with a filled fluid container to set its sample. Once set, it supplies an unlimited amount of that fluid. Use a fresh drum for a different sample.
